sections.title: 5. New customer setup and three-day card trial

blocks.text: New customers must save their company and ideal customer profiles and complete Choose Your Plan & Payment before entering the full Intent Radar dashboard. Setup-only AI capacity is bounded and is not a free product trial. Authentication, saved setup, billing and cancellation remain accessible while product access is restricted.

A new eligible trial lasts exactly 72 hours from provider-confirmed activation. You must select Starter, Growth or Scale, provide a supported card through secure provider-hosted checkout and explicitly accept recurring authorization. No subscription payment is due during a free trial. The selected plan then renews automatically each month unless canceled. Hosted checkout shows the exact charge amount, currency, first-charge date/time and cancellation terms before authorization. If an unavoidable card-verification charge is required, it must be disclosed and authorized separately; otherwise the advertised free path is unavailable.

Trial limits are five searches, three AI operations, 150,000 reserved AI tokens, one manual monitor and one user. Scheduled checks, reports, developer API and MCP require paid allowances. One trial is allowed per verified person and business domain; earlier trials count toward eligibility. Failed, canceled or unverified checkout grants no trial or paid access. Existing customer trials and purchased entitlements retain their recorded terms.

Monthly subscription prices are USD59 for Starter, USD149 for Growth and USD379 for Scale. Enterprise is quoted individually. Yearly checkout is disabled until exact prices and allowance timing are approved. Published allowances are subject to their versioned catalog and the verified contract snapshot.

Eligible international checkout uses Creem, the merchant of record, with tax-inclusive USD product prices. Creem calculates and discloses applicable taxes, payment totals and invoices under its terms. PlaneByte does not store card numbers or CVVs. India uses PayU only when account-specific capabilities and approved INR prices or explicitly verified supported conversion are available. Changing a country field does not verify billing location or switch an existing provider. PlaneByte has no GSTIN and does not independently add unverified GST.

Each provider path opens only after merchant permissions, payment acceptance and applicable disclosures are verified. A browser success page is not payment evidence. We activate access only after authenticated provider confirmation and independent reconciliation. Product creation or a webhook test does not establish payment or payout readiness.

sections.title: 7. Subscription renewal, cancellation and legacy purchases

blocks.text: A Creem monthly subscription renews using the provider-confirmed billing period and schedule, rather than an internal timer that charges stored cards. Your selected plan, amount, currency and renewal date are displayed before authorization and in Billing & Subscription. Provider-confirmed failed, unpaid, paused, disputed or expired states can restrict product access while preserving billing and cancellation controls.

You may cancel future automatic billing through Settings → Billing & Subscription or the secure provider portal without contacting support. Cancellation is complete only when confirmed by the provider. During a trial, cancel before the first-charge date to prevent conversion. Confirmed cancellation preserves access until the agreed current period ends unless mandatory rights, a verified refund or a security restriction require otherwise. We show and email confirmed cancellation; if a request is unverified, we say so and allow status refresh or recovery.

Existing PayU one-time purchases remain manual prepaid access: monthly access lasts30days, early renewal starts after existing expiry, and the original snapshot governs future terms. An ordinary one-time payment does not authorize recurring charges. PayU recurring mandates are offered only when merchant-approved, with required consent, mandate verification and pre-debit notices. No silent provider transfer, early upgrade, proration or unused-time credit is promised. Plan changes with new monetary consequences require the provider checkout disclosures and explicit authorization.

Plan allowances, daily safety limits and capacity limits are distinct. The workspace usage view shows the applicable period and remaining capacity. Scheduled checks consume the applicable search and monitor allowances. AI operation counts, reserved token capacity, reported provider tokens and estimated provider cost are separate measurements; an estimate is not a guarantee of actual cost or complete token reporting.

Limits are enforced on the server. Retries reuse the relevant operation record where supported; an uncertain provider outcome may retain reserved capacity until reconciled. The service can refuse further operations when capacity is exhausted, access expires or a safety limit is reached. Existing saved research is retained according to the approved retention policy. Do not bypass limits, share credentials to evade seat restrictions, or manipulate client state to obtain unpurchased access.

For an initial paid purchase, request refund review within seven days of verified payment through Billing or contact@planebyte.com. Include the payment reference and reason without card information. We review duplicate charges, billing errors, service circumstances and applicable rights. No undisclosed usage-percentage exclusion or universal no-refund rule applies. Renewals and other requests are reviewed under their agreement and mandatory rights.

Canceling a future renewal, leaving checkout, account closure and refunding an already captured payment are separate actions. A free trial has no subscription payment to refund. Refund success and timing are confirmed through the provider; submitting a request does not move money or prove bank settlement. Existing payment and audit records may be retained where legally required.

You retain your rights in content you provide. You authorize processing of that content to operate the requested service, secure the account, provide support and perform the workflows you authorize, as described in the Privacy Policy. You must have the necessary rights and permissions for that content.

PlaneByte retains its rights in the service, software and branding. Your access permits use within the purchased or trial scope; it does not transfer ownership of the software. Third-party materials remain subject to their owners' rights. AI output may not be unique and is not a representation that all underlying material is exclusively owned by you or PlaneByte.

Do not use the service unlawfully, infringe others' rights, bypass access controls, impersonate another person, attempt unauthorized security testing, extract private content without permission, or interfere with another workspace. Do not use credentials, integrations, sources or developer tools beyond their authorized scope.

Product access does not authorize cold outreach, mass messaging or disregard of consent, opt-outs and suppression requirements. Features unavailable in your workspace must not be accessed through direct API calls or workers. Report a suspected vulnerability privately to contact@planebyte.com without exposing customer information.

We may restrict activity necessary to address account compromise, unlawful use, material misuse, provider restrictions or risks to the service or other users. We will provide an explanation and a route to support when lawful and practicable. A temporary restriction is not authority to erase retained customer or accounting records.

Service availability depends in part on third-party infrastructure and providers. No uninterrupted service, service-level credit, compliance certification or particular performance commitment is promised unless a separate written agreement expressly supplies one. We may maintain and improve the service; changes affecting paid access are subject to the applicable purchase agreement, approved refund policy and mandatory rights.

You may download personal account details and use the available workspace research exports, or request a full export through Sign-in & Security or contact@planebyte.com. Once account closure is verified through the review process, ordinary account data is scheduled for deletion or anonymization within 30 days, subject to the exceptions below. Backups are removed through their normal retention cycle, targeted at no more than 90 days after verified closure. Access expiry alone is not a closure request, and a submitted request does not immediately erase a workspace.

Submit an authenticated data request in Settings → Account → Sign-in & Security, or contact contact@planebyte.com. The application records a case reference. Support verifies identity, organizational authority, the requested scope and applicable retention exceptions before confirming closure or deletion. Additional information is requested only as needed for a proportionate review. Verified closure starts the tracked retention deadlines; no deletion is claimed until the case has been fulfilled and verified. Contact the same channel with the case reference for status or escalation. Deletion may be limited by applicable legal obligations, payment/refund records, disputes, fraud/security needs, legal holds, and the need to preserve contact history and suppression records. A member's deletion request must not automatically remove records controlled by another authorized workspace or erase evidence required to honor an opt-out. We will explain applicable limitations through the approved process.

Use reasonable care in evaluating source material and AI output, preserving your own necessary records, and managing authorized users. We remain responsible for obligations that applicable law does not permit us to exclude. Nothing in these Terms removes mandatory consumer or data-protection rights, excuses fraud or willful misconduct, or limits liability where such a limitation would be unlawful. No monetary liability cap, indemnity or exclusive foreign court is imposed by these Terms.

We will identify the published version and effective date of these Terms. Contact contact@planebyte.com to raise a service or billing concern and provide the relevant workspace/order reference without sending passwords, verification codes or card details. Formal notices use the contracting identity and address in section 1. Applicable mandatory law and lawful rights to seek regulatory or judicial remedies remain available; no unapproved governing-law or venue clause is invented. We do not represent a source quote as an AI-verified fact, or claim a provider training/retention opt-out that has not been contractually verified. sections.title: 6. Service providers, disclosures and processing locations

blocks.text: The current architecture uses Vercel for the application frontend, Google Cloud for the API/workers and Vertex AI, Neon PostgreSQL for stored application data, PayU for hosted payments, and Netlify for the separate marketing website. Resend delivers transactional account messages. Payment processing is unavailable until the specific merchant permissions and checkout acceptance have been verified; including PayU in this disclosure does not mean checkout is open.

Providers receive information relevant to the function they perform. The application API/workers are deployed in India and the current database region is in the United States; other provider processing depends on the applicable service configuration and agreements. Do not infer that all information remains in one country. Applicable cross-border processing requirements and provider disclosures must be verified before publication.

We may disclose information to authorized workspace users, necessary service providers, professional advisers handling a relevant matter, or public authorities where disclosure is lawfully required. We may also preserve or disclose appropriate records to investigate security incidents, fraud, disputes or legal claims. Such disclosures must be limited to the relevant purpose and authority. This Policy does not authorize sale of workspace content or unrestricted disclosure to data partners.

Creem handles eligible international checkout as merchant of record, including payment processing, applicable tax and its hosted billing portal. PayU handles eligible Indian payments under merchant-specific capabilities. Provider privacy and payment terms apply to information submitted directly to them. Billing country evidence is used for lawful routing; IP location or an editable country choice alone is not verification. Subscription-related messages include trial, payment, failure, cancellation and refund notices. We do not treat a successful checkout as evidence that merchant payouts have settled.

The application uses essential session cookies and security mechanisms for authentication and protection of account actions. It may store functional preferences such as theme, navigation state and workspace context. Production authentication cookies are protected against ordinary client-side access and use secure transport settings.

Disabling essential cookies can prevent sign-in and account functions from working. A theme preference is separate from permission to perform research, access a source, process a payment or send outreach. Any nonessential analytics or advertising technology requires its own accurate disclosure and applicable consent controls; no advertising or analytics consent is bundled into an account verification code.

Account verification, password recovery, explicit team invitations, payment confirmations, renewal/expiry notices and important security messages support the requested service. Delivery is bounded, deduplicated and subject to suppression and authorization checks. A queued message does not establish that it arrived; delivery and complaint events may be processed from the configured email provider.

General workspace notifications require the relevant enabled feature and recipient preferences. Bulk outreach and marketing are separate from transactional messages and are not authorized merely by enabling account email delivery. An opt-out or suppression record may need to be retained so the choice continues to be honored. The approved deletion process below will explain the scope of such retention.

sections.title: 9. Retention after expiry or account closure

blocks.text: Fixed-term access expires at its recorded time without automatically deleting saved research, payment history or other retained records. Workspace closure, personal account closure, expiry, membership removal and a verified deletion request have different effects.

After verified account closure, ordinary account data is scheduled for deletion or anonymization within 30 days, subject to justified exceptions below. Backup removal follows the normal retention cycle, targeted at no more than 90 days after verified closure. These targets come from the owner’s launch policy. The operator records closure and its deadlines; submitting a request alone does not execute a purge. Existing workspace exports and a personal account-detail download are available, and a fuller export can be requested for review.

Retention must account for the purpose and applicable obligations for each record category. Accounting/refund records, consent and security records, legal holds/disputes, contact/message history and suppression information can require different treatment from an unused research draft. Backups are recovery copies; any eventual deletion process must define how deletions remain effective after recovery and how retained backup copies age out, without promising immediate removal from every copy.

Depending on applicable law and your relationship with the workspace, you may have rights to obtain information about processing, access or correct your personal information, request erasure, withdraw consent, raise a grievance, or use other rights available to you. A workspace administrator can help with organizational records within that administrator's authority. Applicable rights are not limited to the application controls currently available.

Use Settings → Account → Sign-in & Security to submit an authenticated full-export, account-closure/deletion or erasure-review request, or contact contact@planebyte.com. The application acknowledges the request with a reference. Support reviews identity, workspace authority and retention exceptions, requests proportionate clarification where needed, and records verified closure and the applicable 30/90-day targets. Use the case reference with the same contact for status, correction or escalation. Request handling also observes any additional applicable legal requirements. No named privacy officer or legally required designation is invented.

Use the approved channel and provide enough context to locate the relevant account/workspace without sending a password, OTP or unnecessary identity document. Verification should be proportionate and prevent one person from deleting another person's or organization's records. We will explain any valid reason a request cannot be completed in full and any available escalation or review route under the approved process and applicable law.

Deletion or withdrawal may affect features that need the relevant information. Retention may remain necessary for payment/refund and legal records, fraud/security investigations, dispute resolution, lawful holds, contact history or suppression choices. No blanket exception permits keeping every record indefinitely, and no request automatically authorizes a production reset or deletion of another workspace. Closing access is not a substitute for implementing and verifying an approved deletion request.

The service uses workspace authorization, protected authentication/session records, server-side secret handling, access controls and protected storage/transit mechanisms appropriate to the relevant component. No system can guarantee absolute security. We do not claim a security certification or guarantee against every incident.

We investigate suspected incidents, take appropriate containment and recovery measures, and provide notifications required by applicable law and the relevant agreement. Contact contact@planebyte.com if you suspect unauthorized access, and avoid disclosing another person's information or credentials in the report. Support, privacy and security escalation use contact@planebyte.com, addressed to the business owner, Piyush Agrawal.

The service is intended for authorized business use. It is not designed to solicit children's personal information. If information appears to have been supplied without the authority or lawful consent required for that person, contact us so it can be assessed through the approved request process. No unapproved age threshold or guardian-consent mechanism is asserted by this draft.

The published Policy will identify its version and effective date. sections.title: Billing errors, duplicates and uncertain payments

blocks.text: Contact us about an incorrect or duplicate charge even if you are unsure whether the initial-purchase window applies. We reconcile the specific transactions before deciding what action is appropriate. A pending payment is not assumed successful. Check your payment history and contact support before paying again when a prior result is uncertain.

A recorded request is an acknowledgement of review, not proof that money was refunded. PayU processes the financial transaction. A refund is treated as completed only after independent provider verification; actual banking credit timing can vary. We do not promise a settlement deadline that the provider has not confirmed.

sections.title: Renewals, subscriptions and legacy fixed terms

blocks.text: Canceling a subscription prevents provider-confirmed future renewal; it does not automatically refund a prior charge. Renewal refund requests remain subject to the actual agreement, service circumstances and mandatory rights. Initial paid purchase requests remain eligible for review within seven days. No blanket exclusion of mandatory rights applies.

Legacy PayU fixed-term purchases retain their original manual-renewal terms. New recurring trials require hosted card authorization and a selected conversion plan; no subscription charge is due during the advertised72hours. Yearly checkout remains disabled. Refunds are processed only through approved provider workflows and are not assumed successful from a browser return.

A full refund independently confirmed in the original purchase currency revokes the access attributable to that purchase. It does not delete saved research, another purchase or the original accounting record. Partial refunds and missing currency evidence require review; they do not automatically create a new entitlement or a credit balance. Payment/refund and other justified retention exceptions are explained in the Privacy Policy.
Contact contact@planebyte.com with the case/order reference for status or escalation. Nothing in this policy limits rights that applicable law does not permit us to exclude.

Review the confirmed effective date. Cancellation must be confirmed by the provider; a pending or failed request is not shown as successful. Billing and cancellation remain accessible even if product access is restricted.

For a72-hour card trial, cancel before the displayed first-charge date/time to prevent the selected monthly paid plan from starting. Once cancellation is provider-confirmed, no later automatic charge is authorized by that subscription. Trial or current paid access continues to its agreed end unless mandatory rights, a verified refund or a security restriction require otherwise. A confirmation is shown and sent by transactional email.
Legacy one-time PayU purchases do not automatically renew and never authorize a recurring card mandate. Their saved start/end dates and original manual-renewal terms remain unchanged.

If hosted checkout is canceled, fails or remains unverified, your onboarding stays saved at Choose Your Plan & Payment. No trial or paid access is granted. You may reconcile or safely retry the saved checkout. Reaching a success URL does not activate a subscription. Canceling checkout does not refund an independently captured payment; use the refund-review workflow where applicable.

sections.title: Provider, plan changes and payment failures

blocks.text: Subscription billing country and provider are verified server-side. You cannot silently switch an existing subscription between Creem and PayU by editing a country field. Plan changes must disclose the provider amount, effective date, recurring terms and any approved proration before authorization. We do not invent INR prices or activate unapproved PayU mandates.

For failed renewal, use Billing & Subscription or the secure provider portal to review payment recovery. Product operations may be restricted while the provider reports unpaid, past-due or expired access; authentication, billing and cancellation remain available. Yearly checkout is unavailable until approved.

The request is recorded and reviewed for identity, workspace authority and retained-record obligations. It does not immediately delete data, remove another user's records or issue a refund. Ordinary account data is scheduled for deletion/anonymization within 30 days after verified closure, with backup aging targeted within 90 days, subject to justified exceptions in the Privacy Policy.

Expiry of access alone preserves saved research under the applicable retention policy. Closure of a personal account and the handling of an organization's workspace are separate matters; organizational authority must be verified. Contact support before closure if you need help exporting records or transferring authorized workspace ownership.
